_frame: ⚠️ SAME FRAME AS `local_layouts.json`, ONE TIER UP — bearing + distance from a region centre, but in KILOMETRES rather than metres. CCode suggested that and it is right: the machinery is built and gated, and a second coordinate convention would be a second thing to get wrong.
_whatIDoNotSupply: ⛔ NOT THE GROUND. CCode bakes coastline and relief from the generator, and it cannot disagree with the world because it IS the world evaluated once. I supply only what lies BELOW the information floor — the things the generator is silent about.

the_echo_vale.purpose: ⛔ THE GROUND BETWEEN TWO CIVILISATIONS THAT DO NOT FIGHT AND INTERFERE ANYWAY. Sound bends light here; light carries sound. ⚠️ NOTHING IN THE VALE IS NEUTRAL AND NOTHING IN IT IS ANYONE'S — which is why the people who live here are the ones who wanted out from under both.

namedGround.name: The Shimmer
namedGround.why: ⛔ THE INTERFERENCE ITSELF, and the thing players actually navigate by. Between the two powers, soft-edged and WANDERING — the vortices move, so this is a band and not a boundary. ⚠️ 'Past the shimmer' is already how a player described crossing it in play (Cellaceron, worldDay 32).

_shapeFindings: ⛔ FOUR REGIONS, FOUR SHAPES, AND THE FRAME BENT TWICE. ECHO VALE: a band between two powers. THE CENTER: a HUB — four of eight members share one bearing and distance because they ARE the Crossing, so the ways matter more than the ground. THE PALELANDS: a MARCH that runs out and stops, whose far edge is defined by ABANDONMENT and not by terrain. ⚠️ UMBRAL DEPTHS NEEDED `level` AT REGION SCALE — the Slow Stair changes depth ALONG its length, which no other route does. ⛔ `level` was authored for interiors; a region can be vertical too, and CCode should expect it on ways and on named ground, not only on sites. ⚠️ ALSO NEW: an edge of kind `none`. The Palelands and the Quickwood are antipodal and DO NOT TOUCH — recorded so nobody draws a border between them.
_frameNote:
⛔ SNG-418. CENTRES ARE MINIMUM ENCLOSING CIRCLES. THIRD DEFINITION AND THE LAST.
  1. arithmetic mean of lat/lon — MINE, wrong near a pole (3.01° out on the Centre)
  2. lat/lon bounding-box midpoint — CCode's, wrong the same way
  3. spherical mean direction — correct, but MINIMISES THE SUM of distances
  4. ⛔ MINIMUM ENCLOSING CIRCLE — minimises the MAXIMUM, which is what a radius IS
⚠️ CCode spotted that the valley's 24.1° radius had a tighter option at 19.9°. He was right and the true minimax is tighter still: 15.7°, THIRTY-FIVE PERCENT smaller. Umbral Depths gained 32%, the Riven Marches 21%.
⛔ THE POINT IS RENDERING, NOT PURITY: the radius sets how much of the frame a region fills, so a 35% smaller radius is a 35% more zoomed map showing the same places. A mean direction is the right centre for asking 'where is this region'; a minimum enclosing circle is the right centre for DRAWING it.
⚠️ Standing rule for the remaining ~22: MINIMAX, and never the arithmetic mean.

_waysFix:
⛔ SNG-421. CCODE MEASURED THAT NONE OF THE 22 WAYS CONNECTED THEIR ENDPOINTS — path/direct 4.85×, and no bearing sense, handedness or scale fixed it. HE ASKED WHICH OF THREE THINGS WAS TRUE. ⚠️ IT WAS OPTION 2, AND FOR A WORSE REASON THAN HE OFFERED ME.
He guessed the canon positions had moved under me. ⛔ THEY HAD NOT. THE LAST WAYPOINT MATCHES B IN ALMOST EVERY WAY — the chains END correctly and never START correctly. That is not drift; that is my having authored bends BY EYE from a printed table and never once checking they joined A to B. I described a road I could picture instead of a path between two known points.
⛔ ALL 22 RE-DERIVED: each now interpolates its endpoints along the great circle, with a perpendicular bend whose SIZE AND SIGN come from the authored reason. The reasons were always real; only the geometry was invented.
⛔ AND I DROPPED THREE WAYS WHILE FIXING THEM. My rewrite built a `keep` list that only collected the SKIPPED branches, so the Echo Vale — the region with the most ways — was left holding only the degenerate one. ⚠️ CAUGHT BY RUNNING CCODE'S OWN DETOUR TEST AFTERWARDS AND COUNTING 18 WHERE THERE SHOULD HAVE BEEN 21. Restored. A fix that silently deletes content is worse than the bug it fixes, and the only reason this did not ship is that I verified against his measurement instead of my own.
